what_differs: WagerTech needs to create manual redeposit allocations in several batches per month, entered as rep + amount + volume with automation creating the individual records, and on 2026-09-30 the manual path was set to be built before the CSV upload. WAGR-464 describes only 'Ops uploads the monthly allocation from Jay's tool' and 'Ops handles exceptions'; no ticket states the manual/bulk entry or its build order.
suggested_action: Suggestion: add the manual bulk-allocation requirement (rep, amount, volume; repeatable batches) and the manual-first build order to WAGR-464, then create a build story.
